name: cuda-edi
description: Greenfield EDI runtime (SQS FIFO + durable Lambda). Strangler for Legacy cuda-edi-api.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cuda-edi/edi-core && npm run build -w @cuda-edi/enqueue-sdk && npm run build -w @cuda-edi/enqueue-lambda && npm run build -w @cuda-edi/outbound-worker && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cuda-edi/edi-core && npm run build -w @cuda-edi/enqueue-sdk
scripts.build:lambdas: npm run build -w @cuda-edi/enqueue-lambda && npm run build -w @cuda-edi/outbound-worker
scripts.synth:dev: npm run build && cdk synth --context environment=dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --context environment=dev
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --context environment=test
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --context environment=prod
